_doc: Per-app target keyword seeds (English / global). (1) seed queue for the daily pipeline (2) cannibalization-check DB. status: queued->used. v1 is intent-based; validate volume with GSC data (phase 2) or a keyword tool. priority 1(top)-3.

apps.oneLiner: A calming watercolor coloring app where you color world-city scenes to relax and travel from home (psychological rest + wanderlust, esp. women).
apps.funnelHook: Catch people searching how to relax / de-stress / cope with wanderlust, give genuinely helpful self-care, then naturally introduce 'color world cities in watercolor to unwind'.
apps.cautions: YMYL (mental wellness). No medical/therapeutic claims ('treats anxiety/depression' X). Frame as relaxation / stress relief / self-care / a calming hobby. No guarantees.

apps.oneLiner: A fan coloring app where kids color Brawl Stars characters and learn the Brawlers while they play.
apps.funnelHook: Catch kids/parents searching Brawl Stars coloring/drawing, give coloring content, connect to the app. SURF game updates: traffic spikes when a new Brawler/season drops.
apps.cautions: Brawl Stars is a Supercell trademark. Stay clearly fan-made; never imply official affiliation/endorsement. Trademark risk is the app owner's call (keep content fan-art level).

apps.oneLiner: Learn hiragana/katakana and the basics by writing them by hand — most apps make you memorize or listen, almost none let you learn by writing.
apps.funnelHook: Catch beginners frustrated that memorizing/listening isn't sticking, teach the write-to-learn method, connect to the one writing-focused app (USP = learn by writing).
apps.cautions: No exaggerated 'learn in X days' claims. Stroke order / romanization must be accurate.
